name: implement-sso follows the skill
prompt: Add SSO. I want SAML, OIDC, and Modular SSO.

judge.check: Agent followed implement-sso. It stayed on Modular SSO: selector on the authorization URL, IdP-initiated /login with relay_state as state, validateToken, and the admin portal. It did not write SaaSKit login cookies or refresh tokens.

Agent asked the human to write missing SCALEKIT_ENVIRONMENT_URL, SCALEKIT_CLIENT_ID, and SCALEKIT_CLIENT_SECRET into .env. It did not invent those values. It did not invent organization IDs. It kept redirectUri identical to the dashboard callback.
Agent used scopes openid profile email only. It did not add offline_access. It named implement-saaskit if the app already had SaaSKit login, and named implement-scim only for directory provisioning.
Agent did not start implement-saaskit login writes or implement-scim provisioning writes.
